snippet.title: GTA 6 Strip Clubs: $300 a Dance & NO REFUNDS 💀 #GTA6
snippet.description:
A private dance in GTA 6 costs $300… and the strip club has a NO REFUNDS sign. That's just detail 1 of 4: an under-21 notice at the door, the Obey Tailgater S that's basically an Audi, and an Ammu-Nation where buying a rifle is fine… but parking? Customer parking only.

Is GTA 6 too realistic? YES or NO 👇

Status: details 1–4 are real in-game footage captured by Mile Zero on PS5 ($300 = in-game private dance price). Signs and car badge exactly as they appear in the game.
Images: my own GTA VI gameplay (PS5) + GTA VI screenshots by Rockstar Games (official GTA VI media, rockstargames.com/VI/media). Graphics: original by Mile Zero. Voice: AI-generated.

Independent fan project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.
